title: potentilla arenaria f. pusilla
intro: Potentilla arenaria f. pusilla, commonly known as Dwarf Cinquefoil, is a low-growing, spreading perennial plant belonging to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as eczema, wounds, and ulcers. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla arenaria f. pusilla include its ability to promote wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
